verdict.rationale: Square exposes an extensive API surface covering payments, refunds, disputes, payouts, invoices, subscriptions, webhooks, and even an MCP server for AI agents, suggesting broad parity with UI functionality. However, there's no evidence of a public OpenAPI spec being discoverable (404s on standard paths), a community comment notes historical gaps (subscriptions API existence resolves this but suggests some UI features lag API support), and no explicit confirmation that all seller-facing dashboard features (e.g., fraud rule configuration, engagement/marketing tools) are fully API-accessible.
